output.reason: The release note [ev-8ab94de966ea] says only that 'compareoptions default values' were updated. The linked PR [ev-ed6f68b198cb] describes two separate behaviour changes: resource status is now ignored in diffs for all resources, not just CRDs, and user-defined differences are now automatically added to ignored resource updates. Neither excerpt names the config keys or gives exact before/after values, and neither says which setups are exposed (for example, only those that don't set these options explicitly) or what an exposed environment sees. The PR edited the 2.14-3.0 upgrade guide and argocd-cm.yaml [ev-3f74391dbd4d], but that content isn't shown, so that guide section or the settings diff is needed to write a typed assertion for each of the two changes.
